identity.real_world_identity_notes: Ligier Automotive specifies the JS P320 LMP3 with an Xtrac 1152 six-speed sequential gearbox and semi-automatic pneumatic steering-wheel paddle shift. AMS2 places it in the P1 Gen2 simulator class, whose exact class ID is P1Gen2.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a closed GT/Formula rim with an integrated display; exact diameter remains unknown.

notes: With Auto Clutch disabled, the car stalled when moving from rest without physical clutch input; a physical clutch is therefore required for starts in AMS2.
Six paddle-selected forward gears accepted clutch-free full-throttle upshifts without driver lift, and automatic cut was perceptible.
Clutch-free downshifts were accepted with the driver's foot off throttle, and automatic blip was directly visible as a throttle-display spike.
Live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with Auto Clutch disabled.
The car stalled when physical clutch input was omitted from move-off.
Six paddle-selected gears, no-lift clutch-free running upshifts with automatic cut, clutch-free downshifts with automatic blip, and a closed GT/Formula display rim were observed directly.

confidence.basis: The exact simulator identity and complete user-facing control technique were directly tested; the manufacturer independently establishes the gearbox hardware.

claims.basis: Official addition plus exact live model and P1Gen2 class observations through SimHub 9.11.22.
Constructor specification and direct exercise of all six paddle-selected forward gears agree.

The no-clutch start test stalled the car. Running tests directly demonstrated no-lift clutch-free upshifts with perceptible cut and clutch-free downshifts with a visible automatic-blip throttle spike.
Direct cockpit inspection showed a closed GT/Formula rim with an integrated display.

notes: The required standing-start clutch is deliberately distinct from clutch-free running shifts.

The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "prototype", a value that named a racing category rather than a rim outline. That value is retired: the rims it covered are the same closed form, flattened at both the top and the bottom, that the project now records as "gt-style". The shape was remapped by definition and the rim was not observed again.

The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "gt-style". The separate "gt-style", "formula" and "prototype" values described the same rim: molded grips at 9 and 3 with a control face between them, usually carrying a display and rev lights. They are merged into "gt-formula". The rim was not observed again and nothing about the observation changed.
driver_summary: Xtrac 1152 six-speed sequential with pneumatic paddle shift, to Ligier's own specification for the LMP3 car. It cuts and blips for itself, but the clutch is yours to pull away.
